title: Fix static-vs-param priority and 405 Method Not Allowed in HTTP router
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `mini_router/router.py`:
1. Static path segments must take priority over `:param` segments regardless of route registration order (e.g. registering `/users/:id` before `/users/me` must still match `/users/me` to the static handler).
2. Normalize trailing slashes (`/users/` matches `/users`, except root `/` stays `/`).
3. Return `(405, None, {})` when the path matches one or more routes for *other* HTTP methods, and `(404, None, {})` when no route matches the path.
Run `pytest` to verify.
